U.note: Grounds fire in a burned-ewes record and a scholar who never saw one, with honest disputes over clutch size; long but earns it.

V.note: Rain-wyrm with a chin pearl and a ferryman's disputed measurement is vivid and well-argued, with a slightly chatty preamble.

X.note: Compact, plate-style and consistent, but dry and visibly a Komodo/frilled-lizard remix.

Y.note: Competent generic fantasy-bestiary entry with stock ember dragon and standard sections; padded safety and journal notes.

Z.note: Thorough taxonomic entry with synonyms, lifecycle and lookalike table, but long and a bit encyclopedic.
